name: Sugimiya Taku
source: Osamu's second son and Takeshi's younger brother. Upbeat and energetic, he tries his best to cheer up the household after his mother passed away, but has been unsuccessful in getting his father and brother to open up. Taku looks up toward Heikichi like an older brother and longs to grow up and be like him, but where will their bonds lead to?
